name: Instrumented
docs:
A [`Future`] that has been instrumented with a `tracing` [`Span`].

This type is returned by the [`Instrument`] extension trait. See that
trait's documentation for details.

[`Future`]: std::future::Future
[`Span`]: crate::Span

must_use.reason: futures do nothing unless you `.await` or poll them

availability: Observed in the hosted capture; reachability is separate from raw visibility. Consumer dependency/features/target must be checked independently.
